ceu: ✦ The conjunction between Venus and Saturn

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: Today's emotions run through your wallet and through what you consider yours. Protect what you have built, without closing yourself off.
Venus and Saturn are together in {S:0}: affection and harmony, discipline and responsibility, all focused on your image and your personal energy. Do not scatter yourself: one goal at a time.
s.d: Ask for what you are owed, politely and without fear.

t: The Moon passes through your sign today and leaves your emotions close to the surface: it is a day to listen to yourself first and decide later.
Venus and Saturn are together in {S:0}: affection and harmony, discipline and responsibility, all focused on rest and your inner life. It is a good day to start something in this area.
s.d: Before saying yes to someone, ask yourself whether it is also a yes for you.

t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.
Venus and Saturn are together in {S:0}: affection and harmony, discipline and responsibility, all focused on friends and plans for the future. There is more intensity than usual, so take it easy.
s.d: Say a short prayer or meditation for your peace.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: With the Moon in your house of dreams, the future feels closer. Write down a wish and a first step.
Venus and Saturn are together in {S:0}: affection and harmony, discipline and responsibility, all focused on your career and your goals. The energy is all in one place: use it with intention.
s.d: Invite someone for a coffee or a walk.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: The Moon asks you for responsibility and vision. Think about what you want to build over the coming months.

Venus and Saturn are together in {S:0}: affection and harmony, discipline and responsibility, all focused on study, travel and broad horizons. Listen to what this area has been asking of you for a while.
s.d: Keep a promise you made to yourself today.

t: A day to step out of your mental routine. Try a different path, even a small one.

Venus and Saturn are together in {S:0}: affection and harmony, discipline and responsibility, all focused on intimacy and what you share with others. What you do here today has more strength than usual.
s.d: Sign up for, or find out about, a course that interests you.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: The Moon passes through your deepest area. Emotions arrive with intensity, and with them the wish for truth.
Venus and Saturn are together in {S:0}: affection and harmony, discipline and responsibility, all focused on relationships and partnerships. A decision made today will stand on firm ground.
s.d: Trust a secret only to someone who has already proved worthy of it.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: Today relationships need attention: a partner, an associate or a close friend needs to feel your presence.
Venus and Saturn are together in {S:0}: affection and harmony, discipline and responsibility, all focused on routine, daily work and health. Focus, and leave the rest for tomorrow.
s.d: Do not try to change the other person: try to understand them.

t: With the Moon in your house of daily work, practical tasks go well. Start with the one you keep putting off.
Venus and Saturn are together in {S:0}: affection and harmony, discipline and responsibility, all focused on pleasure, creativity and romance. The sky points the way: all you have to do is follow it.
s.d: Start the day with the hardest task and the rest will feel light.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: The Moon lights up love, children and the inner child we all have. Laugh more and worry less.
Venus and Saturn are together in {S:0}: affection and harmony, discipline and responsibility, all focused on home and family. A new beginning may be born from here.
s.d: Laugh at yourself when something goes less well.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.
Venus and Saturn are together in {S:0}: affection and harmony, discipline and responsibility, all focused on conversations, contacts and short trips. This is where your strength lies today.
s.d: Make peace with a childhood memory.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: The Moon passes through your area of conversations: messages, calls and quick meetings set the pace of the day.
Venus and Saturn are together in {S:0}: affection and harmony, discipline and responsibility, all focused on your money and what you value. Put your willpower at the service of what matters.
s.d: Apologise for a careless word, if need be.
